product_contract.persistence: Each settings picker writes its normalized HotkeyRegistrationRequest fields to UserDefaults and reloads the same selection after relaunch.
product_contract.conflict_fallback: An in-app selection conflicting with the main shortcut resolves to the supported non-conflicting modifier before registration.
product_contract.monitor_lifecycle: AppDelegate immediately reloads the global monitor after direct settings changes and posted configuration notifications, stopping the prior registration before recreating it.
product_contract.dispatch: Carbon press and release callbacks route main, in-app, and quit requests to their established Switcher session behavior.
product_contract.visible_workflow: A delivered shortcut opens the appropriate app or focused-window session, and the quit shortcut terminates the selected app through the visible panel workflow.
product_contract.pressure: Focused Control-Tab fast start reads the published projection without consulting the focused-snapshot bridge and remains bounded at 1000 windows.

production_path: AppSettingsView and HotkeySettingsCard convert picker values into normalized registration requests.
AppPreferences persists the selected key code and modifier fields in UserDefaults.
AppDelegate observes direct and posted changes, stops the active OptionTabHotkeyMonitor, and recreates it from the current preferences.
OptionTabHotkeyMonitor registers the Carbon hotkey and dispatches press and release callbacks.
SwitcherPanelController consumes the callback through the main, focused-window, or terminate-selected-app path.
Existing Mock and real-fixture UI workflows establish the visible result after delivery.
